In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/console/pull/16560):

># [RFE-8100](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RFE-8100): Edit Label Modal customization
>
>**Jira ticket:** https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RFE-8100
>
>
>## Analysis / Root cause
>
>CNV and other dynamic plugins maintain their own labels editing modal because `useLabelsModal` always submits via `k8sPatchResource` on `/metadata/labels`. Consumers cannot run custom label-update logic (e.g., multicluster patches) while reusing the standard modal UI.
>
>## Solution description
>
>Add an optional `onSubmit` parameter to the public `useLabelsModal` hook and `LabelsModalOnSubmit` type. When provided, `BaseLabelsModal` calls `onSubmit(resource, labels)` instead of the default patch. The parameter is forwarded from the hook through `LazyLabelsModalOverlay` to the modal. Existing callers without `onSubmit` are unchanged. Updated SDK JSDoc, `CHANGELOG-core.md`, and generated `api.md`.
>
>**Files changed:**
>
>- `frontend/packages/console-dynamic-plugin-sdk/src/extensions/console-types.ts`
>- `frontend/packages/console-shared/src/hooks/useLabelsModal.tsx`
>- `frontend/public/components/modals/labels-modal.tsx`
>- `frontend/packages/console-dynamic-plugin-sdk/src/api/core-api.ts`
>- `frontend/packages/console-dynamic-plugin-sdk/CHANGELOG-core.md`
>- `frontend/packages/console-dynamic-plugin-sdk/docs/api.md`
>
>## Screenshots / screen recording
>
>N/A — no visual changes to the modal UI.
>
>## Test setup
>
>- Local Console from fork: `yarn dev` in `frontend/`, `./bin/bridge` with `BRIDGE_PLUGINS=kubevirt-plugin=http://localhost:9001/`
>- Kubevirt plugin linked to local SDK: `@openshift-console/dynamic-plugin-sdk` → `file:.../dist/core`
>- `oc login` to a cluster with resources that support label editing
>
>## Test cases
>
>- [ ] Default behavior: `useLabelsModal(resource)` still patches `/metadata/labels` via `k8sPatchResource`
>- [ ] Custom submit: `useLabelsModal(resource, onSubmit)` invokes the callback with resource and labels object on Save
>- [ ] Modal closes on successful custom `onSubmit` promise; errors display in modal footer
>- [ ] Existing Console callers (details page, `useCommonActions` Edit labels) work unchanged
>- [ ] TypeScript: plugin consumers can pass optional `onSubmit` per updated `UseLabelsModal` signature
>
>## Browser conformance
>
>- [ ] Chrome
>- [ ] Firefox
>- [ ] Safari (or Epiphany on Linux)
>
>## Additional info
>
>Backward-compatible public API extension for [RFE-8100](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RFE-8100). Enables CNV to replace its custom labels modal with Console's `useLabelsModal` while keeping custom patch logic.
>
>**Example usage:**
>
>```tsx
>const launchLabelsModal = useLabelsModal(vm, (resource, labels) =>
>  customUpdateLabels(resource, labels),
>);
>```
>
>## Reviewers and assignees
>
>- @vojtechszocs 
>- CNV consumer: Gal Kremer (RFE reporter/requester per [RFE-8100](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RFE-8100))
>

`@logonoff` Here is the `/plugin-api-review` for PR `#16560`:

---

## Plugin API Review — `useLabelsModal` optional `onSubmit` ([RFE-8100](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/RFE-8100))

### ✅ Passes

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Backward compatibility — `onSubmit` is optional in all types/props | ✅ |
| `UseLabelsModal` type updated correctly in `console-types.ts` | ✅ |
| `onSubmit` forwarded from hook → `LazyLabelsModalOverlay` → `BaseLabelsModal` | ✅ |
| `useCallback` dependency array updated to include `onSubmit` | ✅ |
| Null/undefined label values normalised to `''` before `onSubmit` is called | ✅ |
| Existing callers (`useCommonActions.ts`, details pages) pass no `onSubmit` and remain unaffected | ✅ |
| JSDoc and `CHANGELOG-core.md` updated | ✅ |
| `api.md` updated with `onSubmit` parameter description | ✅ |

---

### ⚠️ Issues Found

#### 1. `LabelsModalOnSubmit` is **not exported from the SDK public API barrel** — plugin consumers cannot import it

The `api.md` TypeAlias table lists 27 types and **`LabelsModalOnSubmit` is absent**. Searching the SDK `src/` index files confirms no barrel re-exports the type. This means a plugin author writing:

```ts
import { LabelsModalOnSubmit } from '`@openshift-console/dynamic-plugin-sdk`';
// ❌ This import does not exist
```

...will get a compile error. Consumers wanting a typed callback would have to duplicate the type inline or use a manual annotation — defeating the purpose of exporting it at all.

**Fix needed:** Add `LabelsModalOnSubmit` to the SDK barrel (wherever `UseLabelsModal` is re-exported from `core-api.ts`) so it appears in the public `@openshift-console/dynamic-plugin-sdk` surface, and update the TypeAlias count in `api.md` from 27 → 28.

---

#### 2. `LabelsModalOnSubmit` is defined twice independently — structural drift risk

The type is declared in two completely separate files with identical bodies:

- **Internal** — `frontend/public/components/modals/labels-modal.tsx:211`
- **SDK public** — `frontend/packages/console-dynamic-plugin-sdk/src/extensions/console-types.ts:1084`

TypeScript's structural typing makes them compatible today, but they can evolve independently and diverge silently. The internal file should consume the SDK type rather than redeclare it:

```ts
// labels-modal.tsx — instead of redefining, import from the SDK
import type { LabelsModalOnSubmit } from '`@console/dynamic-plugin-sdk/src/extensions/console-types`';
// and re-export for convenience if needed:
export type { LabelsModalOnSubmit };
```

---

#### 3. Minor — `api.md` example still shows only the no-`onSubmit` form

The `useLabelsModal` example in `api.md` (`PodLabelsButton`) only demonstrates the original usage. The new custom-`onSubmit` example from the JSDoc in `core-api.ts` was not mirrored into `api.md`. Since `api.md` is the generated consumer-facing reference, it would be helpful to add the second example there too.

---

### Summary

The implementation is functionally correct and backward-compatible. Two actionable items before merge:

1. **Required:** Export `LabelsModalOnSubmit` from the SDK public barrel so plugin consumers can actually use the type.
2. **Recommended:** Eliminate the duplicate type declaration by having `labels-modal.tsx` import `LabelsModalOnSubmit` from the SDK types rather than redefining it.
3. **Nice-to-have:** Add the custom `onSubmit` code example to `api.md`.
